summary.zh: opinion-manager 新增标签选择引擎（Profile schema 2.2）：一条规则可带多个标签，context select --tag 按标签并集读取规则，core 输出常驻规则与标签索引，check 由标签派生交付信号；自定义规则可用 [tags …] 行尾标记带标签，inbox add / revise 新增 --tag。既有 2.0 与 2.1 的 Profile 与 OPINION.md 字节不变。
summary.en: opinion-manager gains a tag selection engine (Profile schema 2.2): a rule can carry several tags, context select --tag reads the union of the chosen tags, core prints the always-loaded rules with a tag index, and check derives delivery signals from tags; custom rules can carry tags through a trailing [tags …] marker, and inbox add / revise gain --tag. Existing 2.0 and 2.1 Profiles and OPINION.md bytes are unchanged.
